name: Wooblay Supervision
description: Enterprise agent supervision layer — approvals, identity, receipts, scoring, and audit trails for every tool call.

gateUrl.description: URL of the Wooblay Gate server

signingKeyPath.description: Path to the Wooblay signing key directory

agentKeyName.description: Name of the signing key pair files

toolFilter.description: Which tools to gate: all, only risky (exec/browser/write), or custom list

customToolList.description: Custom list of tool names to gate (only used when toolFilter is 'custom')

approvalTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for waiting on approval decisions (default: 5 minutes)

approvalPollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in ms when waiting for approval decisions
